name: Tidus Stair
summary: At Tidus Stair, two tauren shamans seek insight from the coastal water spirits. Broad stone terraces rise above the Merchant Coast southeast of Ratchet, sheltered beside the Great Sea.

sections.title: Steps to the Sea
sections.body: Waves crash below the weathered stone terraces of Tidus Stair, cut into the coastal bluffs southeast of Ratchet. The Barrens around you are arid and dusty, and skirmishes trouble the region, but this stretch above the Merchant Coast is quiet. A modest hut stands on the terraces, home to the tauren Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer. Far from the goblin trade docks, they spend their days fishing, watching the horizon, and seeking insight from the coastal water spirits.

aliases: how to get to tidus stair
faq.answer: Tidus Stair lies along the eastern coast of the Barrens, directly southeast of the goblin port of Ratchet. It overlooks the waters of the Merchant Coast.
Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer, two tauren, live here in a simple seaside hut on the terraces. They spend their time fishing and communing with nature.

faq.q: Why is Tidus Stair significant to shamans?
faq.answer: Horde shamans seeking to master water are guided across Kalimdor to find Islen Waterseer at Tidus Stair. Beside the open ocean, initiates learn to commune with the tides and seek pure waters to bind their water totem.

faq.q: Is Tidus Stair aligned with the Horde or neutral?
faq.answer: The tauren who live at Tidus Stair are loyal to the Horde and guide Horde shamans. The remote terraces lie outside formal military borders.

angles.text: As a Horde shaman, you eventually journey down these coastal steps to seek Islen Waterseer during your trials to bind the water totem.
As a tauren, you can see in Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer how tauren seers keep a spiritual vigil far beyond Mulgore's borders.
